releaseNotes: Smart Lookup & Merge has been redesigned around a simpler workflow for updating one sheet from another.
Choose the sheet to update, select the new data, let Elmashad suggest how rows match, choose the values to bring over, then review everything before applying.
Smart Lookup can bring multiple values in one operation and automatically suggests the destination columns.
Advanced matching, duplicate and conflict controls remain available when needed.
Clearer navigation, friendly empty states and a plainer preview before anything is applied.
